queries.query: Koudougou Burkina Faso cadastral map parcels official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Burkina Faso's official DGI e-Cadastre viewer, official DGI guidance naming the Koudougou provincial tax office as the cadastral-extract service location, and an official 2025 Koudougou cadastral-plan annex. The e-Cadastre public map/API route was then inspected directly.

queries.query: Koudougou Burkina Faso cadastre parcelles carte foncière service officiel
queries.result: La recherche en français a identifié le portail officiel e-Cadastre de la Direction générale des impôts, la FAQ officielle précisant que le service cadastral de Koudougou se trouve à la Direction provinciale des impôts, et le portail gouvernemental des e-services qui référence la gestion du cadastre. Une réponse GeoJSON publique et anonyme a été obtenue sur le service e-Cadastre.

registryCustodian: Direction générale des impôts (DGI), Burkina Faso; local cadastral service evidenced by the official DGI FAQ at the Direction provinciale des impôts in Koudougou.

registryEvidence.interpretation: This is local registry/cadastre evidence, not merely national agency prose: DGI's first-party FAQ explicitly names the Koudougou service location, and the first-party e-Cadastre viewer returned Koudougou parcel geometry.
registryEvidence.localEvidence: The exact-point API response NAME identifies Burkina Faso; Centre-Ouest; Boulkiemdé; Koudougou, establishing the local commune context for the returned parcel.

nativeFieldMapping.FID: opaque native parcel feature identifier retained as canonical id
nativeFieldMapping.NAME: source composite location/reference string; not retained in sample

sourceReview.compositeKeyProvenance: The source NAME was observed as Burkina Faso;Centre-Ouest;Boulkiemdé;Koudougou;00;01;001;34;02. It was used only as schema/context evidence and is not used as the retained sample identity.
sourceReview.crs: EPSG:4326, reported by the GeoJSON response; coordinates are longitude/latitude in geometry while the WUP point is preserved latitude/longitude.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified public viewer HTML returned; Angular module scripts identified, including current main bundle. No login or private token used.

TLS-verified public JavaScript inspected. It identifies the public api/locations/geojson route and the official WMS URL https://data2d.ecadastre.dgi.bf/geoserver/cadastre2D/wms with layer cadastre2D:cadastre.

TLS-verified anonymous response returned one Feature with FID ulJBtjmx4Ih, MultiPolygon geometry, and CRS EPSG:4326. The source NAME identifies Koudougou; source-specific properties were not retained.
TLS-verified bounded city-area probe returned a FeatureCollection with parcel features; raw response retained only under ignored tmp/ for evidence, not as a packet artifact.
TLS-verified anonymous request returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. No credentials, private token, or bypass was attempted; this did not affect the successful public GeoJSON route.
Official DGI FAQ states that Koudougou cadastral extracts are issued at the Direction provinciale des impôts and describes cadastral geometry/cartographic content.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact WUP point queried without coordinate shift; one public feature was returned. The sample preserves the unchanged full native MultiPolygon geometry and only the canonical id property.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DGI e-Cadastre public map/API and Koudougou local cadastral service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous parcel GeoJSON delivery verified at the exact WUP point and in a bounded Koudougou-area probe; citywide completeness and update coverage were not established.

scopeLimits: One exact-point feature and a bounded area response do not prove complete citywide coverage or parcel absence outside the queried extent.
The exact-point result is evidence of a parcel hit, not evidence that the city has only one parcel.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Only one sample GeoJSON is retained and it contains exactly one canonical native id plus full polygon geometry; source-specific attributes remain in metadata only.
No coordinate was shifted, no login or CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass was attempted, and TLS verification was not disabled.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The public DGI e-Cadastre route, schema, CRS, Koudougou context, and one safe native identity-plus-geometry sample are verified. The opaque FID's long-term stability, API pagination/limits, city boundary coverage, completeness, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified.
